page_title: BOU 2-2 MNU | Bournemouth v Manchester Utd 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' The attendance is 11229.
90+9' Andre Onana leaps to intercept the corner kick from Lewis Cook (Bournemouth).

90+9' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Enes Unal (Bournemouth) on the edge of the box. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bournemouth.
90+7' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Tony Harrington changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement. Bournemouth are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
90+6' Celebrations by Bournemouth are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.

90+5' Tony Harrington blows his whistle and signals a foul after Willy Kambwala (Manchester United) brought his opponent down. PENALTY! One of the players from Bournemouth is about to take a penalty kick.
90+4' Excellent touch by Romain Faivre (Bournemouth)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
90+4' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ryan Christie (Bournemouth). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

90+3' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
90+3' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth win a corner kick.
90+1' The referee shows a yellow card to Neto (Bournemouth). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) leans back and sends a volley well wide of the right post from inside the box.
86' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
86' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
85' Lewis Cook races towards the box before laying off to Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth), who picks it up but drags a shot well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
84' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
82' Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) sends a long ball forward to Lloyd Kelly, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
82' Tony Harrington blows his whistle after Amad Diallo (Manchester United) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Bournemouth are awarded the free kick.
80' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) works the corner short.
78' The game has come to an end for Kobbie Mainoo. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Mason Mount (Manchester United).
77' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
76' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is substituted due to injury. Andoni Iraola gives a chance to Enes Unal.
73' Romain Faivre (Bournemouth) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

71' A cross by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
71' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
70' The manager makes a subsitution with Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) coming on for Adam Smith.
70' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Romain Faivre (Bournemouth) replaces Dango Ouattara.
67' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
65' 2 - 2 Goal! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Neto into the bottom right corner.
65' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
64' The players claim that Adam Smith (Bournemouth) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Manchester Utd.
63' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.
61' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
59' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is about to take a corner kick.

59' Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
56' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
51' Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andre Onana intercepts the ball.
51' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.

50' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders.

48' The cross into the penalty area from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
46' The game is over for Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United). Amad Diallo comes on for the second half.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+9' The end of the first half.
45+8' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tries his luck with a long-range shot, but the ball crashes against the bar. Great effort!
45+8' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
45+5' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.

45+4' It's unbelievable, Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot to the bottom right corner from a few yards out, but Andre Onana reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
45+4' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
45+3' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul. Bournemouth have a free kick.
45+3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Neto, who smothers the ball.
45' We will have 9 min. of added time.

43' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar! Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) blows a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He pounced on a rebound but headed it just over the crossbar.
39' Andoni Iraola is forced to make a change. Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Lloyd Kelly.
38' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) picks up an injury.

36' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Marcos Senesi slips the ball through to Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:1.
34' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) does well inside the box to bring down a pass from Dominic Solanke. He gets away a decent shot but it creeps just past the right post.
33' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth).
31' 1 - 1 Goal! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.

30' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Andre Onana pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
29' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
28' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) collects a wonderful lead pass and as he has a lot of space, smashes a terrific shot from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the crossbar!
27' Casemiro (Manchester United) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
26' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
26' 5:1 – the total goal attempt statistics. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:0.
21' That was close. Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
19' The ball is crossed into the box and Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the left side of the goal, but Andre Onana gets a glove on it to thwart him.
18' A brilliant individual effort! Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post.
16' 1 - 0 Goal! Marcos Senesi plays a long ball to Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 1:0.
14' Manchester Utd are ruled offside.
11' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is behind the touchline and Manchester Utd will take a throw-in.
10' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
7' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
5' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) sends a long ball forward to Luis Sinisterra, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
3' Bournemouth can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Manchester Utd will take the kick-off.
Tony Harrington is the one to supervise the game today.
